Design exactly twelve nonredundant bundles of one to three EXISTING structural fields specifically for NAS-Bench-201 edge-operation single and double edits. There are six directed edge slots in a four-node cell. none is an absent edge, never an effective path edge. skip_connect is an edge operation. All fields keep their supplied definitions. The examples are random structures and legal edits WITHOUT observed performance. Propose structural hypotheses, never claim empirical benefits. Do not prescribe beneficial directions, high-score architectures, gains, thresholds, support IDs or hard action permissions. The program will later learn sign-conflict partitions from its own online Validation edit records; positive, negative and zero outcomes all remain. Do not encode exact graph IDs or memorize examples. A feature bundle is a possible context distinction, not a proven performance rule. Cover different native structural mechanisms, with no requirement for a preferred operation mixture. FULL-COVERAGE CONTRACT: Every one of the 22 named fields in feature_catalog MUST appear in at least one returned bundle. Return exactly 12 unique bundles, each with 1 to 3 distinct existing field names. All valid bundles will be active; there is no truncation. Strengthen structural interpretation by deliberately relating background to edit effect, or parent structure to post-edit consequences, or untouched operation context to edited-path relationships where meaningful. Use coherent combinations rather than arbitrary field packing, and allow useful overlap between bundles. Do not simply return 22 singleton bundles. Keep meanings concise and describe structural distinctions and boundaries, never expected accuracy or beneficial operation directions. Do not change field definitions, invent derived fields, output thresholds, model weights, numerical gains, evidence IDs, or executable rules. Before returning JSON, check the union of all features equals exactly the 22 provided names, no field is omitted, no bundle is duplicated, and each bundle has at most three fields. Coverage is mandatory but not a claim of better performance. Use no information other than the supplied grammar, field definitions and unlabelled examples.
